title: Aldrin's communion as Masonic ritual on the Moon

tellings.quote: Buzz Aldrin planted they did like communion and then Buzz Aldrin like it was a masonic ritual on the moon.
Aldrin then proceeded to carry out the first religious ceremony ever conducted on the moon.
tellings.difference: Calls it the first religious ceremony on the Moon and does not frame it as a Masonic ritual.
tellings.link_reason: Both tell of Aldrin's 1969 communion on the Moon during Apollo 11, told by the host.

as_told.title: Buzz Aldrin's communion on the moon

plain: Michels says that during Apollo 11 in 1969 Buzz Aldrin took communion on the Moon, and in one episode calls it "like a masonic ritual on the moon." In another episode he describes it more plainly as "the first religious ceremony ever conducted on the moon," without the Masonic framing. He tells it himself, without naming a source, as a hint that ritual and secret societies were bound up with the space program.
